Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Empowering our Clients with People-Driven Digital Innovation Across Europe We are a Group managing digital IT services and solutions, driven by people, innovation, agility, and deep industry insight. We are working with the largest private and public institutions to deliver IT services and solutions. Being an entrepreneurial digitalservices group with a Human-Sized Tech Company, we are built by passionate experts and led by seasoned leaders in IT and digital transformation.
 About the role 
 As the Support Engineer, you will act as the single point of contact for production incidents and service requests. You will help ensure stable platform operation, efficient incident handling and clear communication with the countries using the service.
 You will monitor platform health and extraction performance, perform initial technical analysis, coordinate investigations with relevant technical specialists, and contribute to service reporting, documentation, maintenance and continuous improvement.
 Key focus areas 
Incident management and service requests.
Platform health, extraction-performance monitoring and reporting.
Initial technical diagnosis and coordinated escalation: Level 1 support and coordination of Level 2 investigations.
Coordination of technical adjustments.
System availability, operational performance, maintenance and continuous improvement.
 Main responsibilities 
Act as the single point of contact for IRIS production incidents and service requests raised by countries or operational stakeholders.
Monitor platform health, service availability, processing status and extraction-performance indicators.
Perform initial issue analysis, collect evidence, reproduce problems where possible and assess business and service impact.
Classify, prioritize, track and document incidents and requests throughout their lifecycle.
Monitor incident and service-request resolution against agreed priorities, service levels and escalation timelines.
Resolve L1/L2 issues within the agreed support scope and coordinate investigations with technical specialists when specialist expertise is required.
Ensure timely escalation to the appropriate Level 3 experts and maintain clear ownership and follow-up until resolution.
Communicate incident status, workarounds, dependencies and resolution information clearly to country stakeholders and relevant teams.
Coordinate approved prompt, configuration and Python adjustments, and perform limited changes within documented procedures and the agreed support scope.
Escalate AI-related changes requiring tuning or advanced technical expertise to the Data Scientist. Validate implemented corrections and monitor post-resolution behaviour to confirm service recovery and extraction quality.
Contribute to regular service reporting, including platform performance, incident trends, recurring issues and improvement actions.
Maintain support procedures, troubleshooting guides, known-error records, operational documentation and knowledge articles.
Identify recurring issues and propose preventive actions, automation opportunities and improvements to monitoring, alerting and support processes.
Support country integrations, releases and onboarding of new document types from an operational-readiness perspective.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, shared backlog management and continuous-improvement activities.
 Ways of working 
Work within one shared product backlog, one sprint goal and shared ownership.
Collaborate closely with country stakeholders and relevant technical teams, with clear escalation to Level 3 expertise when required.
Maintain clear documentation, transparent status reporting and a strong focus on service quality, delivery and continuous improvement.
 What we are looking for 
Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
At least 3 years of experience in application support, production support, technical operations, DevOps or a comparable role.
Experience supporting business-critical applications in a multi-team and international environment.
Good understanding of incident, problem, change and service-request management practices.
Ability to work in a structured manner during operational incidents, with strong ownership and clear stakeholder communication.
Fluency in English; another European language is an advantage.
 Technical and professional skills 
Working knowledge of Python and SQL for investigation, validation and controlled technical adjustments.
Experience with application and platform monitoring, log analysis, alert handling and performance reporting.
Experience with ServiceNow for incident and request management.
Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON payloads, HTTP status codes, asynchronous data processing workflows, batch execution and integration troubleshooting.
Knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines.
Knowledge of Jira for Agile backlog management and collaboration.
Familiarity with OCR, document processing, data extraction or AI/ML-enabled applications is an advantage.
Knowledge of service-management principles; ITIL Foundation certification is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, customer orientation, collaboration, adaptability and delivery focus.
 We offer 
  Competitive salary and the opportunity to have a meaningful job where you can make a difference 
  The chance to continuously evolve as a professional 
  Medical insurance & Meal tickets. Variety of training opportunities
 Join Us at EASYDO 
 With a team of 250 dedicated professionals, we combine technological excellence with a people-first culture. We believe in empowering talent, nurturing careers, and building long-term trust with our clients and our teams.
